title: Dublin Bay
html_source:
Dublin Bay is a C-shaped inlet of the Irish Sea on the east coast of Ireland
Imagine standing on a tower’s parapet gazing over this beautiful sight.

 — The bard's noserag! A new art colour for our Irish poets: snotgreen. You can almost taste it, can't you?
